learn.title: How steep is a line?
learn.body: Slope measures steepness: how far the line rises for each step right. It is rise over run. Between two points, slope is $m=\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.

learn.title: Four kinds of slope
learn.body: Positive slope rises from left to right. Negative slope falls. A horizontal line has slope 0. A vertical line has undefined slope, because its run is 0.
Subtract the points in the same order on top and bottom. Mixing the order flips the sign of your answer.

questions.prompt: What is the slope of the line through $(0,0)$ and $(2,6)$?
questions.explanation: Rise is 6 and run is 2, so slope is $\frac{6}{2}=3$.
It does not rise at all, so the rise is 0 and the slope is 0.
Its run is 0, and dividing by zero is not allowed, so the slope is undefined.

questions.prompt: A line has slope 2 and passes through $(1,3)$. What is $y$ when $x=4$?
questions.explanation: Moving 3 steps right raises the line $3\cdot2=6$, so $y=3+6=9$.
